bio.text: Arnold Jensen, a Republican, has represented Connecticut House District 131 since January 8, 2025.
According to Ballotpedia, he earned a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering from Stony Brook University and a certificate in computer programming from NYU, and worked as an engineer for Unilever.
As of his 2024 campaign, he was an Oxford Selectman, and he previously served on the Oxford Roads Commission.
